question: If A can complete a task in 10 days and B is 25% more efficient than A, how long (in days) will it take them to complete 60% of the task when they work together?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of efficiency of A : B = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5 Total work = Efficiency of A × Days taken by A = 4 × 10 = 40 units. 60% of Total Work = 40 × (60 ÷ 100) = 24 units. Combined efficiency = 4 + 5 = 9 units/day. Required time = 24 ÷ 9 = 8/3 = 2(2)/(3) days. **∴ The correct answer is 2(2)/(3) days.**
